title: Controlling for Stereotypes in Multimodal Language Model Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating masked language model predictions of color terms when provided with images of objects displaying stereotypical colors (e.g., yellow banana) versus unusual colors (e.g., green banana) to measure reliance on statistical priors over visual signals.

Evaluating masked language model predictions of gender-specifying words (e.g., he/she) when provided with images of male or female individuals paired with text prompts describing activities or occupations associated with gender stereotypes.
